items.text: Vikings WRs Jordan Addison (hamstring) and Justin Jefferson (ankle) are both questionable and will work out pregame to determine status. Jefferson said he will do whatever he can to play in Louisiana homecoming.
items.implication: Monitor 90-min window closely; if both out massive vacuum, if Jefferson in still startable.
items.opportunity: If out: elevated targets for other MIN pass-catchers/OBJ

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers, listed questionable for Sunday night due to foot injury, is expected to play vs the Falcons.
items.why: Foot injury but expected to suit up SNF.
items.implication: Full WR1 role with Lamar out; no major downgrade.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey, who didn’t practice this week and is listed as questionable due to a foot injury, is not expected to play vs the Broncos.
items.why: No practice all week, foot injury.
items.implication: Significant target vacuum in LAC; upgrade Quentin Johnston and others.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining LAC WRs

items.text: Steelers will make final determination in pre-game warmups, but RB Rico Dowdle is unlikely to play Sunday vs the Colts due to a toe injury (questionable).
items.why: Toe injury; final call in warmups.
items.implication: Jaylen Warren full workload upgrade if out.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (plantar fasciitis flare + ankle) is hopeful to play but not definite; will work out pregame. LV elevated a RB (Hemby) in case.
items.why: Missed late-week practice; elevated backup contingency.
items.implication: If out, major opportunity for elevated RBs; if limited, monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Backup carry/route share spike if inactive

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive vs Lions as details finalize. Texans remain primary team to watch.
items.why: Trade finalizing; team informed player morning of game.
items.implication: Zero snaps for MHJ; immediate role expansion for remaining ARI WRs, especially Michael Wilson.
items.opportunity: Full target share vacuum in ARI WR room

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) is expected to play against the Vikings, source says.
items.why: Back injury but source confirmation expected.
items.implication: Full RB1 role intact vs MIN.

items.text: Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) and DT Christian Barmore (shoulder) are both expected to play for New England, source says.
items.implication: Lead back role vs LV; no major handcuff elevation.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 5 London game vs Jaguars.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP all week, official OUT.
items.implication: Primary back duties to handcuffs/Shipley/Pierce; Hurts rushing upside up.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled OUT Week 5 vs Jaguars in London.
items.implication: Goedert and remaining WRs (Wicks) see target boost; Hurts checkdowns.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled OUT for SNF vs Falcons; Huntley starts.
items.implication: Major downgrade BAL offense; Likely/Flowers/Henry usage shifts under Huntley.
items.opportunity: TE/WR short-area under backup QB; Henry volume?

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games. He wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. It gives me no pleasure to inform everyone it is Kia Kendrick Bourne szn.
items.why: MHJ low production (5/4 games) means Wilson already had independent role; Bourne elevated post-inactive/trade.
items.implication: Wilson must-start; Bourne streaming upside in vacated targets.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets independent of MHJ; Bourne opportunity spike

items.text: Dallas Goedert expected IN/active for Eagles London game; primary target with Smith/Barkley out.
items.why: Returned to practice; will play as top Hurts target especially RZ.

items.text: Love Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume including red-zone post-MHJ inactive.
items.why: Target volume + matchup; amplified by MHJ inactive/trade.

items.text: Hate Jordan Addison @ NO as WR41; tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle (hamstring Q).
Love Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume/red-zone hog vs weak Titans pass D.
Love Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + soft matchup, boosted if CIN WRs limited.
items.why: Heavy workload vs defense carved by RBs; CIN injury context.

items.text: Hate Jalen Hurts vs JAX in London as QB15; rough stretch + banged-up line/OL issues.
items.why: Recent struggles, OL injuries (Lane Johnson roster notes), London factor.
items.implication: Fade or lower ranking; streaming preferred.
items.opportunity: Reduced efficiency despite Barkley/Smith out rushing upside
items.conflict: Barkley out could boost Hurts rushing but overall fade
